subject_boundary.species_or_population: synthetic longitudinal health and animal-health memory fixture
subject_boundary.site_or_dataset: no real site; derived from public frontier source map only
subject_boundary.transfer_limit: may be reused only as a gate fixture, not as medical or veterinary evidence

consent_state.reuse_scope: MC infrastructure testing and public-safe documentation
consent_state.consent_evidence: synthetic fixture contains no personal, animal-specific, or private health data
consent_state.expiration_or_review_trigger: review when connected to a live memory store or when private fields are introduced

revision_lineage.revision_reason: add governance layer for consent, revision, deletion, contextual transfer, and leakage accounting

deletion_or_redaction_route: Delete or redact the packet file while preserving the README source map and commit history as an audit trail.

contextual_integrity_boundary.source_context: public frontier research scan and synthetic schema design
contextual_integrity_boundary.allowed_transfer: schema requirements and synthetic validation logic
contextual_integrity_boundary.blocked_transfer: transfer of personal health details, veterinary case facts, or real longitudinal records

privacy_loss_route: Repeated retrieval of rare feature combinations must be treated as a leakage route even when direct identifiers are absent.
falsification_route: Reject or revise if curator review shows the gate does not improve unsafe-memory detection or evidence reconstruction compared with prior gates.
